PROPORTION.Definition: a part or share of the whole

CATASTROPHE.Definition: a terrible event that causes great damage and suffering

CONGRESS.Definition: a large formal meeting where representatives discuss something

LANDMARK.Definition: very important because it marks a big change

GLOOMY.Definition: without hope; expecting things to go badly

STRUCTURAL.Definition: affecting the basic way something is organised

SMUG.Definition: too pleased with themselves, in an annoying way

SOLVENT.Definition: a liquid that other substances can mix into completely

BURIES.Definition: puts in the ground and covers

SCRAPS.Definition: small pieces that are left over

BURYING.Definition: putting in the ground and covering

VERIFYING.Definition: checking that something is true or correct

MONITORING.Definition: watching and checking over a period of time
